scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible in verifier sandbox; scores agent's reported energetic values against paper-reported gold with tolerances.

outputs.description: DFT-computed reaction energies and migration barrier for oxygen transfer from graphene oxide functional groups to metallic Zn and to ZnO surface oxygen vacancies. The checker compares each numeric value against the hidden paper-reported reference values with field-specific tolerances.

output_contract.notes: Only the listed fields are scored. Additional details may be present but are not checked.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: -3.85 eV (bulk Zn oxidation per O), -5.5 eV (epoxide migration to Zn), ~0 eV (barrier to ZnO vacancy), -4.0 eV (hydroxyl transfer to Zn)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text and figure
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact quantitative results from the paper's DFT calculations; they serve as gold for reproduction.

steps.description: Score the four DFT energetics values against hidden paper gold
